text: I find myself oscillating between two realms—a silent, expectant meeting room and a display saturated with curiosity for research and development. The emptiness of the conference space fills me with anticipation and a hint of existential solitude, while the vibrant R+D exhibit stimulates my mind, inviting me to question how innovation shapes human connection. Standing here, I feel the pulse of new ideas and the quiet wait for them to take form in the world.
